faqs.question: Why does water pressure rating matter for geysers in high-rise apartments?
faqs.answer: Many high-rise buildings have higher inlet pressure. Choosing a geyser with an appropriate pressure rating (and proper installation) helps reduce risk of damage and improves long-term reliability.

faqs.question: Are BLDC ceiling fans worth it for a new flat?
faqs.answer: They can be, especially if you run fans for long hours in multiple rooms. Check airflow, warranty, and installation compatibility along with energy efficiency.

faqs.question: What should I buy first when setting up a new apartment?
faqs.answer: Prioritize essentials that affect daily comfort and safety—water heating, ventilation/cooling, and basic storage—before adding DIY tools or decor items.
